analysis.overall: The day featured a few dramatic swings, including a dip into the 50s and a notable morning spike following a connectivity issue, but overall managed a decent amount of time in range.

events.title: Afternoon dip
events.description: Glucose drifted down to a low of 59 mg/dL before temporary basal adjustments and time successfully brought it back up.

events.title: Evening meal and disconnect
events.description: A 40g carb meal was bolused, but a subsequent 'Pump unreachable' announcement noted a brief connectivity lapse that let levels climb.

events.title: Late evening correction
events.description: Glucose reached 195 mg/dL, prompting a temporary target and correction bolus to bring the rise under control.

events.title: Morning peak
events.description: Following breakfast and another reported pump connection interruption, glucose climbed to a high of 227 mg/dL before steadying.

events.title: Midday low
events.description: Aggressive correction stacking earlier in the morning led to a steady downward trend, bottoming out around 54 mg/dL by early afternoon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on pump connectivity alerts to catch accidental delivery interruptions before they lead to significant highs.
